body:
## Goal
Provide a dependency-free Node.js HTTP server that answers GET / with an HTML "Hello, World!" so the project has a runnable, verifiable entry point.

## Spec
Single ESM source file using only Node's built-in `http` module — no external web framework or added runtime dependencies. Server binds to `process.env.PORT`, defaulting to `3000` when unset. A GET request to `/` MUST return status `200`, header `Content-Type: text/html`, and a body containing the exact substring `Hello, World!`. package.json declares `"type": "module"` and a `"start"` script that launches the server via `node`. Implementation stays to exactly one source file plus package.json.

## Changes
- `server.js` — creates
- `package.json` — refactors-existing

## Acceptance
- [ ] AC-1: package.json sets "type": "module" and defines a "start" script that runs the single source file with node
- [ ] AC-2: The server binds to process.env.PORT and falls back to 3000 when PORT is unset
- [ ] AC-3: GET / returns HTTP 200 with a Content-Type header of text/html and a body containing the exact text "Hello, World!"
- [ ] AC-4: The implementation consists of exactly one source file plus package.json and pulls in no external web framework

## Verify
- PORT=3100 node server.js & sleep 1; curl -si http://localhost:3100/ | grep -E '^HTTP/1.1 200' && curl -si http://localhost:3100/ | grep -i 'content-type: text/html' && curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -F 'Hello, World!'; kill %1 (e2e)
- node --check server.js (validate)

## Non-Goals
- Additional routes or HTTP methods beyond GET /
- External web frameworks or added runtime dependencies
- TLS/HTTPS, logging frameworks, or process managers
